comment: The distinction among the Health Workforce Registry, HRIS, and Learning Management System is useful. However, the registry is described as holding the authoritative record of what a worker is “qualified and licensed to do,” although authority may be distributed among professional councils, employers, education institutions, and programme authorities. [draft-for-...idance.pdf | PDF]

public.text: The distinction among the Health Workforce Registry, HRIS, and Learning Management System is useful. However, the registry is described as holding the authoritative record of what a worker is “qualified and licensed to do,” although authority may be distributed among professional councils, employers, education institutions, and programme authorities. [draft-for-...idance.pdf | PDF]
public.suggestedRevision: Describe it as the authoritative national reference arrangement that consolidates or links identity, qualification, registration, licensing, and recognised-role information from the legally authoritative source for each attribute.
